name: Shinji Hirako

power.name: Sakanade
power.notes: Spins world perception backwards, upside down, and reverses friend-or-foe allegiances.

powerSteps.title: Shikai
powerSteps.name: Sakanade
powerSteps.desc: A ringed katana that releases a sweet-scented mist, inverting up/down, left/right, and sensory direction for opponents.

powerSteps.title: Bankai
powerSteps.name: Sakasama Yokoshima Hapo Fusagari
powerSteps.desc: Traps him inside a giant golden flower bud while turning all surrounding enemies against one another in mutual slaughter.

powerSteps.title: Hollow Power
powerSteps.name: Hollow Mask & Cero
powerSteps.desc: Donns a pharaoh-like hollow mask to amplify physical strikes and fire sweeping emerald Cero beams.

blurb: The wry and sharp-witted leader of the exiled Visored who was restored to command the fifth division. His optical-inverting Zanpakuto disorients opponents by reversing all directional perception.
storyboard: Anticipation: star-iris silhouette emerges with a brief stagger cue.
Cover: Signature Shinji Hirako color field (#f3baea) expands across screen.
Reveal: Cover dissolves as Sakanade sweeps into focus.

name: Hiyori Sarugaki

power.name: Kubikiri Orochi
power.notes: A massive serrated cleaver blade backed by savage red Cero blasts.

powerSteps.title: Shikai
powerSteps.name: Kubikiri Orochi
powerSteps.desc: A serrated cleaver that tears through armor with raw physical leverage.

blurb: A short-tempered tracksuit-wearing warrior whose sharp kicks keep Shinji in line. She brandishes a serrated cleaver and a skull-horned hollow mask to unleash ferocious close-range fury.
storyboard: Anticipation: brush-stroke silhouette emerges with a brief snap cue.

name: Kensei Muguruma

power.name: Tachikaze
power.notes: Compresses air into wind daggers and channels continuous exploding concussive force through spiked gauntlets.

powerSteps.title: Shikai
powerSteps.name: Tachikaze
powerSteps.desc: A tactical combat knife that shoots explosive reishi wind trails to sever distant targets.

powerSteps.title: Bankai
powerSteps.name: Tekken Tachikaze
powerSteps.desc: Encases his arms in armored metal knuckle-dusters that blast continuous explosive wind shockwaves into anything he punches.

blurb: A blunt combat veteran whose military bearing anchors the frontline defense of the Seireitei. His Bankai transforms his fists into armored engines of continuous concussive detonation.
storyboard: Anticipation: slash silhouette emerges with a brief stagger cue.

name: Mashiro Kuna

power.name: Mashiro Super Kick
power.notes: Natural hollow fusion prodigy capable of maintaining her mask for fifteen hours straight without tiring.

powerSteps.title: Hollow Fusion
powerSteps.name: Mashiro Super Cero Kick
powerSteps.desc: Fuses green hollow mask power into airborne flying drop-kicks that shatter colossal Menos Grande masks on impact.

blurb: An energetic bodysuit-wearing brawler who mastered her hollow mask immediately without undergoing training trials. Her explosive drop-kicks decapitate giant hollows with acrobatic cheer.
storyboard: Anticipation: circle-iris silhouette emerges with a brief snap cue.

name: Rojuro Otoribashi

power.name: Kinshara
power.notes: A golden whip tipped with an ornate flower that conducts musical sound illusions into physical destruction.

powerSteps.title: Shikai
powerSteps.name: Kinshara
powerSteps.desc: A golden flower whip that channels musical vibrations to cause internal sonic explosions inside opponents.

powerSteps.title: Bankai
powerSteps.name: Kinshara Butodan
powerSteps.desc: Summons a troupe of masked dancers who enact musical illusions of fire, water, and life-stealing sound that trick the brain into sustaining physical damage.

blurb: A romantic dandy and music enthusiast who restored harmony to the third division after Gin's departure. His golden whip conducts symphonic illusions that trick opposing minds into physical ruin.

powerSteps.name: Tengumaru

blurb: An afro-sporting former captain who reads manga leisurely while remaining a powerhouse brawler. His giant spiked club ignites into roaring flame pillars when swung with both hands.
